Harness-only code (not application logic):

- `lib/dedupe_variants.mjs`: strictHash/relaxedKey/clusterUF/variants.* — explicitly identified experimental variants (uf_repo_keys, uf_relaxed); strictHash re-states the repo key and is used only for the applicability test and as a UF key
- `lib/emulator.mjs`: globalThis.fetch replacement (upstream emulation, latency, fault injection)
- `lib/render.mjs`: synthetic provider payload renderers (input data, not application logic)
- `lib/pipeline.mjs`: collectPreDedup(): replicates orchestrator steps 1-3 by calling the repository source adapters, normalizers and rankPapers; checked against the real orchestrator in section 3

## 4. Synthetic renderer -> real normalizer round trip (first 200 corpus works per provider; field agreement with ground truth)

| crossref | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 |
| europe_pmc | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 0/200 | 200/200 |
| pubmed | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 | 200/200 |

Expected, by construction: arXiv has no DOI/venue/citation count and its year is the preprint year; PubMed has no citation count; Europe PMC author strings are rendered as "Family G" (surname + initial), so its first-author field differs from the ground-truth "Given Family"; the PubMed normalizer yields "Given Family" from ForeName/LastName.
